What is Good Deeds Day?

Good Deeds Day is a global movement of people who are dedicated to doing good. Started in 2007, Good Deeds Day is now celebrated in 115 countries, with 700+ NGO networks taking part around the world. It is a day dedicated entirely to doing good, for a person, a community, or the planet.
